newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh Truck Q3 boosted by acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh Truck Q3 boosted by acquisition.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said Monday the September, 1996 acquisition of Pierce Manufacturing Inc improved its operating income in the fiscal 1997 third quarter ended June 30.
Operating income rose to $6.8 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1997 compared to an operating loss of $3.8 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1996, the company said.

"Pierce's fire apparatus sales remain very strong and contributed significantly to third quarter earnings," R. Eugene Goodson, chairman and chief executive officer. "Results for the third quarter also continue to reflect significant new product development costs. The company is investing to win the competition for large medium tactical truck programs for the U.S. Army and Marines. It is also expanding the market for its heavy tactical truck models through product extensions and modifications."

Meanwhile, the Pierce unit has embarked on an extensive development program for its fire and emergency market, goodson said, adding that the company is also investing in new suspension, drive, and systems technologies.
Oshkosh shares were up 1-1/2 at 15-3/8 Monday.
